stage.name: A Quiet Soul
stage.description:
You hear a hoarse whisper, but the shadow eludes you no matter where you look.
Do not overlook even the faintest glimmer of hope—hold on to her with everything you have.
<Leak Marker> Randomly selects a deployable low-ground tile and generates a Leak Source
